english.title: Contravene a tree preservation order - Town and Country Planning Act 1990
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in contravention of a tree preservation order made by **(..SPECIFY THE AUTHORITY..) on **(..SPECIFY THE DATE OF THE ORDER..)

(A)_[cut down,uprooted or wilfully destroyed a tree]_
(B)_[wilfully damaged, topped or lopped a tree in such a manner as to be likely to destroy it]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 210(1) and (2) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
in contravention of a tree preservation order
cut down/uprooted / wilfully destroyed a tree OR
wilfully damaged / topped / lopped a tree in such a manner as to be likely to destroy it

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
Preservation Orders replaced by Preservation Regulations as from 06/04/2012. Therefore this CJS Code and Offence Wording is now OBSOLETE. Now See CJS Code TC90034 and Offence Wording document H~~~~~~~~ .

See H9147 for the summary offence where a tree preservation order is contravened by other means.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding £20,000.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
